title: 第 5 讲：将来表达法与主将从现

reading.title: Next Quarter

sentences.en: Next quarter starts on Monday, and our roadmap is almost ready.
sentences.zh: 下季度周一就开始了，路线图基本就绪。

sentences.en: If the new feature ships on time, we will close the biggest ticket of the year.
sentences.zh: 如果新功能按时上线，我们将完成今年最大的工单。

sentences.en: "What will you do if the API changes?" our lead asks.
sentences.zh: "要是 API 变了怎么办？"负责人问。

sentences.en: "If it changes, we will adapt the adapter — that is its job," I answer.
sentences.zh: "它变了，我们就改造适配器——这就是它的本职，"我回答。

sentences.en: The script will check every commit; when the tests turn green, we will deploy.
sentences.zh: 脚本会检查每一次提交；测试转绿，我们就部署。

sentences.en: The team is going to add two small services, and the intern will shadow me for a month.
sentences.zh: 团队打算新增两个小服务，实习生会跟着我见习一个月。

sentences.en: The butler will run the first check automatically.
sentences.zh: 管家会自动执行第一轮检查。

sentences.en: I am presenting the plan tomorrow morning; my calendar already reminds me.
sentences.zh: 我明早要讲这个计划，日历已经在提醒我了。

sentences.en: Remember: plans are cheap, but shipping is a superpower.
sentences.zh: 记住：计划很便宜，交付才是超能力。

reading.translation: 下季度周一就开始了，路线图基本就绪。如果新功能按时上线，我们将完成今年最大的工单。"要是 API 变了怎么办？"负责人问。"它变了，我们就改造适配器——这就是它的本职，"我回答。脚本会检查每一次提交；测试转绿，我们就部署。团队打算新增两个小服务，实习生会跟着我见习一个月。管家会自动执行第一轮检查。我明早要讲这个计划，日历已经在提醒我了。记住：计划很便宜，交付才是超能力

keyPoints.analysis: 时刻表/日程用**一般现在**表将来 — 不用 will

keyPoints.sentence: **If** the new feature **ships** on time, we **will close** the biggest ticket.
keyPoints.analysis: 主将从现：if 从句用一般现在，主句用 will

keyPoints.sentence: The team **is going to add** two services.
keyPoints.analysis: be going to = 事先的计划

keyPoints.sentence: I **am presenting** the plan tomorrow morning.
keyPoints.analysis: 现在进行表将来 = 个人已定的安排

notes.heading: 主将从现（本册最高频考点）

blocks.text: **时间 / 条件从句**（when, if, as soon as, until, before, after）用**一般现在**表将来；主句才用 will / be going to。

rows: If it **changes**, we will adapt.
If it **will change**, we will adapt.
When the tests **turn** green, we will deploy.
When the tests **will turn** green...
I will call you as soon as I **get** back.
I will call you as soon as I **will get** back.

blocks.text: 判别法：从句说的是「条件 / 时间」，不是「预测」— 预测只属于主句。

rows: If the feature ships..., we will close...
从句一般现在 ✅ + 主句 will ✅
What will you do if the API changes?
疑问句同理：主句 will，从句 changes
when the tests turn green, we will deploy
when 从句主将从现

output.prompt: 用 3 句复述下季度计划（路线图 → if 条件 → 实习生安排），至少 1 句主将从现。
output.reference: 线索：路线图 → if 条件 → 实习生安排
output.sample:
Our roadmap for next quarter is almost ready, and next quarter starts on Monday. （时刻表：一般现在）If the new feature ships on time, we will close the biggest ticket of the year. （主将从现）The team is going to add two small services, and the intern will shadow me for a month. （be going to + will）
（范文仅供参考：覆盖三条线索、至少 1 句主将从现即可，不要求逐词一致。）

output.prompt: 写你的下周计划 5 句 — 四种将来各 1 句 + 1 句主将从现。
output.reference:
参考起点：
will: I will write the design doc tomorrow.
be going to: We are going to refactor the auth module.
进行表将来: I am meeting the team on Tuesday.
时刻表: The sprint starts on Friday.
主将从现: If the demo goes well, we will ship it.
output.sample:
I will write the design doc tomorrow. （will：决定 / 预测）
We are going to refactor the auth module. （be going to：事先的计划）
I am meeting the team on Tuesday. （现在进行：已定的安排）
The sprint starts on Friday. （一般现在：时刻表）
If the demo goes well, we will ship it. （主将从现）

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 5 句覆盖四种将来手段 + 1 句主将从现；主题是你的下周计划

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 每个 if / when 从句里的动词是一般现在；时刻表句不用 will；进行表将来句有明确未来时间（tomorrow / on Tuesday）

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 五种手段各就各位、从句无误用 will，即通过

practice.title: 选将来手段 — will / be going to / 现在进行 / 一般现在

questions.stem: Look at those clouds — it ___ rain.（有征兆）
questions.explanation: 看云识雨 = 有征兆 → be going to
时刻表用一般现在（The train leaves at 6:40 ✓）

questions.stem: I ___ having lunch with the client at noon.（已定安排）
questions.explanation: 现在进行表已定安排（I am having lunch with the client）

questions.stem: OK, I ___ help you with that.（临时决定）
We ___ to rewrite the whole module next month.（早有计划）
questions.explanation: be going to + 动词原形：are going to rewrite（计划已久）

questions.stem: If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, the outdoor demo will be cancelled.
questions.explanation: if 从句主将从现（❌ will rain）

questions.stem: I will call you as soon as the build ___ (pass).
questions.explanation: as soon as 时间从句，一般现在（build 三单加 -s）

questions.stem: Before the release ___ (go) out, we will test it again.
questions.explanation: before 时间从句；release 三单 goes

questions.stem: When she ___ (arrive), we will start the review.
If you ___ (not hurry), we will miss the deadline.
questions.explanation: if 从句否定：don't + 原形（主句 will miss 保持将来）

questions.stem: If it will rain, we will stay inside.
questions.reference: If it rains, we will stay inside.

questions.stem: We are go to ship on Friday.
questions.reference: We are going to ship on Friday.
questions.explanation: be going to + 动词原形，go 不能叠加 be going

questions.stem: When I will finish the report, I will send it to you.
questions.reference: When I finish the report, I will send it to you.

practice.title: 计划写作 — 写你的下周计划 5 句 — will / be going to / 现在进行 / 时刻表一般现在 / 主将从现 各一

questions.stem: 写你的下周计划 5 句 — will / be going to / 现在进行 / 时刻表一般现在 / 主将从现 各一。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: will 句 = 即时决定或预测；be going to = 既定计划；进行句 = be + -ing + 将来时间；时刻表句 = 主语是日程/班车/季度类；主将从现句 = if/when 从句用一般现在

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 从句逐个检查是否混入 will；进行句是否有 be；时刻表句的主语是否适合用一般现在表将来

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 五句覆盖四种将来手段各一，且从句不混入 will、进行句带 be，即通过

practice.title: 条件链 — 用 if 写一个部署决策链（3 层）：测试绿 → 部署；部署成功 → 通知；通知发出 → 关工单

questions.stem: 用 if 写一个部署决策链（3 层）：测试绿 → 部署；部署成功 → 通知；通知发出 → 关工单。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 示例：If the tests pass, we will deploy. / If the deploy succeeds, we will notify the team. / Once the notice goes out, we will close the ticket.

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 每层前半句是从句（一般现在），后半句主句（will）；不允许出现 if ... will 的组合

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 三层链完整，每层从句用一般现在、主句用 will，即通过
